methodology: Global-confidence sweep through Ultralytics model.val() on the validation split at each candidate threshold, reading back per-class precision/recall from metrics.box.p/.r. no_helmet is optimized for recall (subject to a precision floor) because it is this checkpoint's weakest class and the one most directly tied to a real safety violation; other classes maximize F1. This is a coarser tool than a true per-class PR-curve extractor -- documented as a limitation, not hidden.
